source.section: PDF page 60 Schedule CA (540) instructions, Line 5a and 5b (Military Retirement Exclusion, federal AGI limit 125,000 / 250,000, 20,000 cap); PDF page 6 and 55 What's New; Form 540 lines 13 to 19 and 31 to 33 (PDF pages 39-40); PDF page 13 Line 18 standard deduction chart and Line 31; PDF page 75 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Single, 58: uniformed-services retirement pay 36,000 and wages 60,000; federal AGI = 96,000, under the 125,000 limit. Form 540 line 13 federal AGI = 96,000.00. Federal taxable income = 96,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 80,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Subtractions: Schedule CA (540) line 5 column B, Military Retirement Exclusion: federal AGI 96,000.00 does not exceed 125,000.00; military retirement pay 36,000.00, capped at 20,000.00 a return = 20,000.00. Schedule CA Part I line 27 column B = 20,000.00 = Form 540 line 14. Additions (line 16): 0.00. Line 15 = line 17 California AGI = 96,000.00 - 20,000.00 = 76,000.00. Line 18 California standard deduction (single, PDF page 13 chart) 5,706.00. Line 19 taxable income = 76,000.00 - 5,706.00 = 70,294.00. Tax on 70,294.00 by the projection's brackets: 11,079.00 x 1% = 110.79; 15,185.00 x 2% = 303.70; 15,188.00 x 4% = 607.52; 16,090.00 x 6% = 965.40; 12,752.00 x 8% = 1,020.16; total 3,007.57. Line 31: the form uses the Tax Table for taxable income of 100,000 or less; the row 70,251-70,350 gives 3,008 (formula result kept in expected). Line 32 exemption credits: federal AGI 96,000.00 is not more than 252,203.00, so no AGI limitation; line 7 personal 1 x 153 = 153.00; line 9 senior 0 x 153 = 0.00; line 32 = 153.00. Line 33 = 3,007.57 - 153.00 = 2,854.57; no other credits (lines 34 to 47 nil), line 48 = 2,854.57. State income tax = 2,854.57.
accepted_approximations: Taxable income of 100,000 or less is taxed by the Tax Table (100-dollar rows, tax at the row midpoint); the projection uses the schedules' exact arithmetic.
